name: Ierissos Town Beach
toddler_notes: Sandy, gentle slope, shallow near shore.
bar_notes: Several cafes/tavernas along the beach road.
notes: The main town beach, faces the open Strymonic/Ierissos Gulf so it takes the full force of easterly winds. Coordinates verified against Wikipedia.

name: Nea Roda Beach
toddler_notes: Sandy and shallow, quieter than Ierissos town beach.
bar_notes: Tavernas and a couple of beach bars near the village.
notes: On the Strymonic/Ierissos Gulf side of the isthmus, so exposed to the same wind direction as Ierissos. Coordinates verified against Wikipedia.

name: Ouranoupoli Beach
toddler_notes: Sandy town beach, shallow entry, lots of shade options.
bar_notes: Busy promenade with many cafes, bars and restaurants, plus toilets.
notes: Faces the Singitic Gulf (west side of the isthmus) - the opposite side from Ierissos, so it's often calm when Ierissos has easterly wind, and vice versa. Coordinates verified against Wikipedia.

name: Trypiti Beach
toddler_notes: Small sandy cove, shallow, generally calm water.
bar_notes: Well-known beach bar right on the sand.
notes: The northern end of the same beach strip as Ouranoupoli (they're continuous), just before the Ammouliani ferry port. Position is an estimate anchored to Ouranoupoli's verified coordinates, not independently confirmed - double-check on a map before relying on it for turn-by-turn directions.

name: Alykes Beach, Ammouliani
toddler_notes: Shallow, calm, turquoise water - very good for small kids.
bar_notes: Tavernas near the beach.
notes: On the western/southwestern coast of Ammouliani island, overlooking Sithonia. Requires the short ferry from Tripiti (~15 min crossing) plus driving. Position is estimated from the island's verified center coordinates (Wikipedia), not the exact beach - double-check on a map before relying on it for directions.

name: Megali Ammos Beach, Ammouliani
toddler_notes: Wide white-sand beach, very shallow water - one of the best for small children on the island.
bar_notes: Beach bar/taverna on site.
notes: The southernmost beach on Ammouliani island, facing the Drenia islets and Ouranoupoli. Same ferry trip as Alykes Beach. Position is estimated from the island's verified center coordinates (Wikipedia), not the exact beach - double-check on a map before relying on it for directions.

name: Pyrgadikia Beach
toddler_notes: Small, calm fishing-village beach, shallow water.
bar_notes: A couple of tavernas by the water.
notes: On the Singitic Gulf coast (same side as Ouranoupoli/Ammouliani, not the Strymonic side like Ierissos), further southwest toward the base of Sithonia. Meaningfully further than Ouranoupoli/Ammouliani and possibly a longer, winding drive - confirm the route and travel time before heading out. Coordinates verified against Wikipedia.

name: Stratoni Beach
toddler_notes: Mixed sand/fine pebble, shallow entry.
bar_notes: Beachfront cafes and restaurants.
notes: North of Ierissos on the same Strymonic Gulf coast, so same wind exposure. Coordinates verified against Wikipedia.

name: Stavros Beach
toddler_notes: Long sandy beach, gently shelving.
bar_notes: Several beach bars and tavernas along the front.
notes: Further north up the Strymonic Gulf coast, technically in the Thessaloniki regional unit rather than Chalkidiki - only worth the drive if you're exploring further afield. Coordinates verified against Wikipedia.

name: Vourvourou (Karidi/Lagoon area)
toddler_notes: Shallow lagoon partly sheltered by Diaporos island - one of the calmest, most toddler-friendly spots in the area.
bar_notes: Multiple beach bars/tavernas.
notes: On the east coast of Sithonia, between Ormos Panagias and Sarti - worth the longer drive on a genuinely windy day since the lagoon stays calm more often than open beaches. Coordinates verified against Wikipedia.

name: Sarti Beach
toddler_notes: Long sandy beach, shallow, but open to the gulf so more affected by wind.
bar_notes: Lots of beach bars and restaurants along the promenade.
notes: Open bay on Sithonia's east coast - only calm when wind isn't from the east. Coordinates verified against Wikipedia.

name: Toroni Beach
toddler_notes: Long sandy bay, shallow water, easy for little ones.
bar_notes: Tavernas and beach bars along the bay.
notes: At the southwest tip of Sithonia on the Toronean Gulf - west-facing, so it can be calm when the east coast is choppy. Coordinates verified against Wikipedia.

name: Possidi Beach
toddler_notes: Shallow sandbar/lagoon, one of the best in the region for toddlers.
bar_notes: Beach cantina/bar near the lighthouse.
notes: On the Kassandra peninsula - a long drive from Ierissos, only realistic if you're already over there that day. Coordinates verified against Wikidata.

name: Sani Beach
toddler_notes: Organized resort beach, shallow and calm, lifeguards.
bar_notes: Multiple beach bars/restaurants.
notes: On the Kassandra peninsula - a long drive from Ierissos, only realistic if you're already over there that day. Coordinates verified against the resort's published location.

name: Kallithea Beach
toddler_notes: Sandy resort beach, generally shallow entry.
bar_notes: Well-established resort town with many beach bars/tavernas along the front.
notes: On the west coast of Kassandra (Thermaikos Gulf side). One of the busiest resort towns on the peninsula. Coordinates verified against Wikipedia.

name: Afytos Beach
toddler_notes: Sandy beach below the clifftop village, generally shallow.
bar_notes: Beach bars/tavernas along the front; the traditional stone village above has more.
notes: West coast of Kassandra, near Kallithea. A traditional stone-built village on a low cliff, a bit quieter/more upscale than the main resort strip. Coordinates verified against Wikipedia.

name: Polychrono Beach
toddler_notes: Long sandy beach, generally shallow entry.
bar_notes: Well-established resort town with many beach bars/tavernas along the front.
notes: Northeastern coast of Kassandra, part of the busy Kriopigi-Polychrono-Chaniotis resort strip. Coordinates verified against Wikipedia.

name: Chaniotis Beach
toddler_notes: Sandy beach, generally shallow entry.
bar_notes: Well-established resort town with many beach bars/tavernas along the front.
notes: Northeastern coast of Kassandra, same busy resort strip as Polychrono/Pefkochori. Coordinates verified against Wikipedia.

name: Paliouri Beach
toddler_notes: Sandy beach near the southern tip of the peninsula.
bar_notes: Tavernas and beach bars near the coast.
notes: Near Cape Paliouri, the southeastern tip of Kassandra. The coordinate above is the village center, which Wikipedia lists as ~2km inland from the actual coast - double-check the exact beach spot on a map before relying on it for directions. Village coordinates verified against Wikipedia.

name: Nikiti Beach
toddler_notes: Sandy beach, generally shallow entry.
bar_notes: Well-established resort town with many beach bars/tavernas along the front.
notes: West coast of Sithonia (Toroneos Gulf side, facing Kassandra). Coordinates verified against Wikipedia.

name: Neos Marmaras Beach
toddler_notes: Sandy town beach, generally shallow entry.
bar_notes: Busy resort town with many beach bars/tavernas along the front.
notes: West coast of Sithonia, near the Porto Carras resort. One of the more popular Sithonia towns. Coordinates verified against Wikipedia.

name: Porto Koufo
toddler_notes: A near-fully-enclosed natural harbor rather than an open beach - very calm water, but check the shoreline/depth near where you'd actually swim.
bar_notes: Tavernas around the harbor.
notes: One of the largest natural harbors in the Mediterranean, near the southern tip of Sithonia - almost fully enclosed by land, so it stays calm in nearly any wind direction. Coordinates verified against Wikipedia.

name: Kalamitsi Beach
toddler_notes: Sandy beach, generally shallow entry.
bar_notes: Tavernas and beach bars near the coast.
notes: Southeastern coast of Sithonia. Coordinates verified against Wikidata.

name: Paralia Katerinis
toddler_notes: Long sandy beach, generally shallow entry.
bar_notes: The main beach for Katerini city - many beach bars/tavernas along the front.
notes: West shore of the Thermaikos Gulf (faces Chalkidiki across the gulf), the closest beach to Katerini city so it gets very busy. Coordinates verified against Wikipedia.

name: Platamonas Beach
toddler_notes: Long sandy beach, generally shallow entry.
bar_notes: Resort town with beach bars/tavernas along the front.
notes: West shore of the Thermaikos Gulf, below the medieval Platamon Castle. Coordinates verified against Wikidata.

name: Leptokarya Beach
toddler_notes: Long sandy beach, generally shallow entry.
bar_notes: Resort town with beach bars/tavernas along the front.
notes: West shore of the Thermaikos Gulf, at the foot of Mount Olympus. Coordinates verified against Wikipedia.

name: Nea Peramos Beach
toddler_notes: Sandy beach, generally shallow entry.
bar_notes: Resort town with beach bars/tavernas along the front.
notes: North Aegean coast west of Kavala city. Coordinates verified against Wikipedia.

name: Nea Iraklitsa Beach
toddler_notes: Large sandy beach, generally shallow entry.
bar_notes: Popular seaside resort with beach bars/tavernas along the front.
notes: North Aegean coast near Kavala city. Coordinates verified against Wikidata.

name: Kavala City Beach (Batis)
toddler_notes: City beach, generally shallow entry - can get busy, check conditions.
bar_notes: City beach with cafes/bars nearby along the promenade.
notes: Kavala's city beach, partly sheltered by the bay. The coordinate used is Kavala's general city-center position (no precise Batis beach coordinate found) - double-check the exact spot on a map before relying on it for directions. City coordinates verified against Wikipedia.

name: Keramoti Beach
toddler_notes: Long, very gently-sloping sandy beach - known as one of the shallower options in the area, good for small children.
bar_notes: Tavernas and cafes near the ferry port/beach.
notes: North Aegean coast opposite Thasos island (the ferry to Thasos departs from here), east of Kavala near the Nestos river delta. Coordinates verified against Wikipedia.
